name: The Missing Shipment
summary: At Ratchet’s docks, Gazlowe is searching for a shipment that never arrived. Dizzywig’s ledger points away from the harbor and toward the Southsea Freebooters, while Gazlowe prepares to reclaim his cargo.

sections.title: Books Balanced at the Docks
sections.body: Ratchet’s trade keeps its docks busy and its accounts difficult to manage. When a shipment goes missing, Gazlowe suspects bad harbor accounts or foul play on the piers. Wharfmaster Dizzywig checks the manifest and says his books are clean. The intake records account for everything. The missing goods never reached the dock.

sections.title: Eyes on the Freebooters
sections.body: Dizzywig’s ledger clears Ratchet’s port of embezzlement, leaving the Southsea Freebooters camped down the coast as the likely thieves. He returns the records and mentions separate crates waiting from Undermine. Then he sends you back to Gazlowe, Ratchet’s chief engineer. Convinced Dizzywig is loyal, Gazlowe turns from supply ledgers to an expedition to reclaim his stolen booty.

faq.answer: Gazlowe’s ledger holds shipping manifests, cargo inventories, and port intake logs for goods arriving in Ratchet. Dizzywig checks whether the missing crates were recorded as received from the ships.
Gazlowe suspects the Southsea Freebooters, pirates camped along the coast south of Ratchet. Dizzywig’s records show no discrepancy at the docks, so Gazlowe turns his attention to the raiders.

faq.q: Why does Gazlowe trust Wharfmaster Dizzywig?
faq.answer: Gazlowe trusts Dizzywig, who is on his payroll and has served him reliably. He believes the wharfmaster knows better than to cheat him and accepts his word that the books are clean.

faq.q: What are the items from Undermine that Dizzywig mentions?
faq.answer: Dizzywig mentions separate goods from Undermine, the goblin capital, waiting for Gazlowe to collect when he has time away from managing the town.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: Returning the ledger to Gazlowe leads to Stolen Booty. You are hired to enter the Southsea Freebooter camps along the Barrens’ southern coast and take back the lost cargo.
Wharfmaster Dizzywig oversees Ratchet’s docks, near the pier platforms where merchant vessels load and unload cargo.

angles.text: Harbor paperwork shows how easily goods can vanish between sea and shore. Smugglers know that trick well.
Ratchet is neutral. Keeping Gazlowe happy helps preserve steady trade routes and goblin neutrality, both of which benefit the Horde.
Operating in the Barrens calls for careful alliances. Helping Ratchet’s leadership supports a reliable Alliance foothold in central Kalimdor.
